criteria.description: Each worker row displays distinct liveness and scheduling badges.
evidence: web/src/routes/workers/+page.svelte renders liveness-* and scheduling-* badges in separate spans.

criteria.description: Workers can be filtered by scheduling state, workload/task kind, label key/value, accelerator, runtime, and online-only liveness.
evidence: filterWorkerRows applies schedulingFilter, taskFilter, labelKeyFilter, labelValueFilter, acceleratorFilter, runtimeFilter, and onlineOnly.

criteria.description: Worker row actions publish Nostr command events instead of mutating worker state directly.
evidence: publishWorkerAction calls publishCommand with worker command request kinds, d/worker/command tags, command content, and resultKinds [7997].

criteria.description: Command publishing is guarded against duplicate/conflicting in-flight publishes per worker.
evidence: pendingCommands plus isWorkerPublishPending disable worker actions while a command is in flight.
